regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 40". Mt. Bachelor and Stevens Pass follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Mt. Bachelor Friday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 42", 23" of it Friday. Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Stowe is forecast for about 23", 13" of it Friday. Jay Peak and Killington follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Stowe Friday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 31". Cypress Mountain follows.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Palisades is forecast for about 15", all of it Sunday. Sugar Bowl and Kirkwood follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Palisades Sunday and Sunday night.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 13". RED Mountain and Revelstoke follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 11", 9" of it Saturday. Vail and Arapahoe Basin follow.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Big White is forecast for about 10", 6" of it Thursday. SilverStar and Sun Peaks follow.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
